errors.text_span: Всички линии се пресичат във времевата ос
errors.evidence: The phrase, which translates to "All lines intersect on the time axis," is ambiguous. The lines intersect each other over time, but they do not intersect the axis itself, except at their start/end points which is not what 'intersect' usually implies in this context.
For the UniCredit Bulbank line, the description states a peak of 17.0% in 2010. However, the chart shows the peak of approximately 17% occurs in 2012. In 2010, the value is about 16%.
For the UniCredit Bulbank line, the description claims it drops to 13.0% in 2011. The chart shows the value in 2011 is approximately 15.5%. The value of 13.0% is reached around 2015.
For the Banka DSK line, the description states it drops to 12.0% in 2015. According to the chart, the value in 2015 is approximately 13.5%.

errors.text_span: продължава да намалява до около 11,0% през 2027
errors.evidence: For the Banka DSK line, the final value in 2027 is reported as 11.0%. The chart shows this value is clearly below 10%, at approximately 9.5-9.8%.
For the ПИБ (FIB) line, the peak in 2009 is stated as 11.5%. The chart shows the peak in 2009 is at 10.0%.
For the ПИБ (FIB) line, the description mentions a dip to 7.5% in 2011. The chart shows the lowest point for this line is around 7.2% in 2013, not 2011.
For the Postbank line, the starting value in 2007 is reported as 10.5%. The chart shows the starting value is approximately 9.2%.
The description for the 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' line states it has round markers. However, the chart shows this line has cross (x-shaped) markers. The round markers belong to the 'ПИБ' line.
For the 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' line, the description states a peak of 17.0% in 2011. The chart shows the highest peak is approximately 16.8% in 2013. The value in 2011 is about 15.5%.
For the 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' line, the description claims it drops to 11.0% in 2015. The chart shows the value in 2015 is much higher, at approximately 16.0%.

errors.text_span: продължава да намалява до около 10,5% през 2027
errors.evidence: For the 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' line, the final value in 2027 is reported as 10.5%. The chart shows the final value is significantly lower, at approximately 9.5%.
